spec_family.name: Exterior Door Repaint
spec_family.description: Condition-dependent repaint of existing exterior entry doors — 3 substrate materials (steel, fiberglass, wood) as primary branching dimension. Combined assess+prep+prime+finish in single mobilization. Substrate material drives cleaning protocol, sanding constraints, primer chemistry, and topcoat chemistry. 3 substrate conditions (sound, failing, rust) drive prep intensity via FAC_DRRP_CONDITION prep multiplier. 3 door complexity levels (slab, panel, grand_entry) drive production rate via FAC_DRRP_COMPLEXITY universal multiplier — grand entry includes sidelites + transom + complex geometry. Hardware removal is MANDATORY (masking discouraged — areas beneath hardware must be sealed). EA-based estimation — each door is a self-contained work unit including slab face, frame/jamb, and all edges. QT3-QT5 range (QT2 excluded — doors are fine-finish substrate requiring hardware removal, proper substrate-specific prep, and two finish coats). Brush is primary application method; spray conditional on door removal. Steel limited to satin sheen per ANSI A250.8. Fiberglass: 100% acrylic products only (oil prohibited). Wood: six-side seal mandatory (manufacturer warranty requirement). Lead-safe RRP gate for pre-1978 buildings. IR-reflective coating gate for LRV <30 dark colors on high-sun-exposure doors. First exterior door repaint spec in the system.

includes: Condition assessment (visual inspection, ASTM D3359 adhesion test, rust evaluation (steel), moisture content (wood), existing coating ID, lead test (pre-1978))
Lead paint evaluation for pre-1978 buildings (EPA RRP compliance)
RRP containment setup, wet scraping methods, HEPA vacuum, and teardown when lead-positive
Hardware removal — ALL locking hardware, strike plates, hinges, address numbers, decorative hardware (mandatory, not masking)
Weatherstrip protection (pull-out or deep-tape)
Threshold / sill plate protection
Glass lite masking (panel and grand entry doors)
Ground / hardscape protection (drop cloth for brush, full tarp for spray)
Siding masking (spray application only)
Substrate-specific cleaning (steel: solvent+TSP, fiberglass: mild soap only, wood: TSP wash)
Scraping failing paint and feather-edge sanding (mandatory when scraping)
Rust debridement SSPC-SP3/SP6 (steel doors with surface rust)
Body filler for dents and imperfections (steel, QT4/QT5)
Adhesion scuff sand on intact paint (steel and wood only, NOT textured fiberglass)
Door-to-frame junction caulk replacement (exterior-grade paintable, NEVER silicone)
Six-side seal verification and coating (wood doors, door removed from frame)
Sanding dust removal (tack cloth all surfaces before coating)
Substrate-specific primer application (DTM for sound steel, zinc-rich for rusted steel, acrylic for wood/fiberglass, stain-block for tannin-rich wood)
Second primer coat at QT5
Interstage inspection, sand, and spot repair (QT4: between finish coats, QT5: between ALL coats)
2 finish coats — 100% acrylic exterior enamel (brush primary, spray conditional)
Door rehang and alignment verification (if removed)
Hardware reinstallation and operation verification
Weatherstrip reinstallation and seal verification
Protection teardown and site cleanup
Final inspection and touch-up
Customer walkthrough

excludes.item: Structural rust (steel doors beyond surface corrosion)
excludes.route_to: Door replacement — HARD STOP gate condition
SF_TRIM_EXT_RP_v1 — clean junction at casing-to-jamb boundary

excludes.item: Screen door or storm door painting

excludes.route_to: SF_DOOR_SLAB_INT_NC_v1 or future interior door repaint spec
Future exterior stain spec — stain states excluded

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier controlling coat count, inspection scrutiny, interstage sanding, and defect tolerance. Doors are fine-finish substrate — QT2 excluded.
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT3=standard (satin, spot prime, 2 finish coats, scan inspection). QT4=premium (semi-gloss, interstage sand between finish coats, body filler for dents on steel, systematic inspection). QT5=superior (gloss, 2-coat primer, interstage sand between ALL coats, raking light inspection, near-zero defect tolerance). Grand entry at QT5 with failing paint = full restoration (12-20 hrs/EA).

configuration_dimensions.description: Door substrate material. Primary branching dimension driving cleaning protocol, sanding constraints, primer chemistry, topcoat chemistry, and failure mode risk.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Steel: solvent+TSP clean, DTM or zinc-rich primer, satin sheen limit per ANSI A250.8. Fiberglass: mild soap/alcohol ONLY (NO hydrocarbon solvents, NO sanding on textured), 100% acrylic products only (oil prohibited), outgassing risk at dark colors. Wood: TSP wash, six-side seal mandatory, acrylic or stain-block primer, moisture content testing.

configuration_dimensions.description: Door complexity level. Drives production rate via FAC_DRRP_COMPLEXITY universal multiplier and glass masking scope.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Slab=1.00x (flat face, minimal detail, single lockset). Panel=1.30x (recesses, raised profiles, multiple edges, 0-1 glass lites). Grand_entry=2.00x (sidelites + transom + complex geometry + 4-8 glass lites + 2-person crew for removal). Restoration is the extreme end of grand_entry at QT5.

configuration_dimensions.description: Existing coating condition. Drives prep labor multiplier via FAC_DRRP_CONDITION on prep tasks.
configuration_dimensions.notes: SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT=1.00x (scuff sand, spot prime). SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT=1.50x (scrape, feather-sand, spot/full prime). SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST=2.00x (SSPC debridement, body fill, zinc-rich primer). Rust is steel-only. Chalking and peeling excluded — uncommon on doors (siding phenomenon).

paintable_items.name: Exterior door unit (slab + frame/jamb + edges)
paintable_items.counting_rules: Each door counted individually as a complete unit. Includes slab face(s), frame/jamb, hinge edge, latch edge, top edge, bottom edge. Grand entry includes sidelite and transom assemblies as part of the door unit.
paintable_items.notes: EA-based estimation. Each door is a self-contained work unit with hardware removal, substrate-specific prep, primer, 2 finish coats, and hardware reinstall. Interior face is a separate spec. Six-side coating on wood doors.

variants.notes: BASELINE. Standard steel panel door repaint. Spot prime bare/thin areas with acrylic DTM. 2 finish coats satin. Brush application. Hardware removal mandatory. Satin sheen per ANSI A250.8.
Fiberglass panel door. Mild soap/alcohol clean ONLY. 100% acrylic primer and finish — oil PROHIBITED. No sanding on textured fiberglass. Glass masking for panel lite.
Wood panel door. TSP wash. Six-side seal access requires door removal. Acrylic primer on bare areas (stain-block override for tannin species). MC testing at bottom rail.
Failing paint on steel. Scrape all loose paint. Feather-sand edges (MANDATORY). Spot or full prime depending on bare area percentage. FAC_DRRP_CONDITION = 1.50x on prep tasks.
Surface rust on steel. SSPC-SP3/SP6 debridement to bare metal. Zinc-rich primer on debrided areas. Acrylic DTM on surrounding sound areas. FAC_DRRP_CONDITION = 2.00x on prep tasks. Steel-only state.
PREMIUM. Sound steel panel door. Interstage sand between all coats. Body filler for dents. Semi-gloss (or satin per ANSI A250.8 on steel). FAC_DRRP_QT = 1.25x on coating tasks.
Premium wood panel door. Door removal for six-side seal. Interstage sand between all coats. Semi-gloss finish. MC testing. FAC_DRRP_QT = 1.25x on coating tasks.

GALLERY. 2-coat primer + interstage sand between ALL coats + 2 finish coats. Body filler for ALL imperfections. Satin sheen (steel limited per ANSI A250.8). FAC_DRRP_QT = 1.50x on coating tasks. Near-zero defect tolerance.
ECONOMY. Slab door — flat face, minimal detail. No glass masking. FAC_DRRP_COMPLEXITY = 1.00x (baseline). Fastest door repaint variant.
COMPLEX. Grand entry — sidelites + transom + 4-8 glass lites. FAC_DRRP_COMPLEXITY = 2.00x on all tasks. 2-person crew for removal. Significant glass masking scope.

RRP variant. Pre-1978 wood door with failing paint and positive lead test. RRP containment + wet scraping + HEPA vacuum + lead-safe disposal. FAC_DRRP_CONDITION = 1.50x AND FAC_DRRP_RRP = 2.00x on prep tasks. Stacked: 3.00x on prep.

MAX NON-RESTORATION. QT5 wood grand entry. Door removal for six-side seal + 2-person crew. 2-coat primer + interstage between ALL coats. 4-8 glass lites masked. FAC_DRRP_QT = 1.50x AND FAC_DRRP_COMPLEXITY = 2.00x. Coating stack: 3.00x.

required_paintscope_inputs.description: Count of exterior doors to repaint. Primary quantity input. Each door counted individually as complete unit.
Count of hardware sets to remove/reinstall. Typically equals door count. Each set includes lockset, deadbolt, hinges, strike plates, address numbers.

required_paintscope_inputs.required_when: door_complexity IN [panel, grand_entry] AND glass lites present
required_paintscope_inputs.description: Total count of individual glass lites across all doors. Drives glass masking task quantity. Slab=0, panel=0-1, grand entry=4-8.
Door substrate material: steel, fiberglass, wood. Primary branching dimension. Per-door attribute.
Door complexity: slab, panel, grand_entry. Drives FAC_DRRP_COMPLEXITY multiplier and glass masking scope.
Existing coating condition: SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT, SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT, SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST. Drives prep scope and primer selection.

required_paintscope_inputs.required_when: When hardscape/walkway is under door work zone
required_paintscope_inputs.description: Ground surface area under door work zone requiring protection. Drop cloth for brush, full tarp for spray.
Boolean flag for pre-1978 building. Triggers EPA Lead-Safe RRP requirements. Shared with exterior trim and siding repaint specs.

protection_zones_required.notes: Hardware REMOVAL is the standard (not masking). All locking hardware, strike plates, hinges, address numbers removed. Areas beneath hardware must be accessible for sealing. Existing zone_id reused from interior door spec.
Glass lites in panel and grand entry doors. Masking paper or pre-taped film per lite. Slab doors = no glass. Grand entry = 4-8 lites. Remove tape within 14 days.
Weatherstrip pull-out or deep-tape protection. NEVER paint weatherstripping. Fixed per door. Pull-out preferred over deep-tape.
Door threshold/sill plate protection. Tape and paper to prevent drips. Full width coverage.
Ground surface under door work zone. Brush: edge-only drop cloth (3-4 ft). Spray on sawhorses: full tarp under sawhorse area plus 6 ft perimeter.
Siding adjacent to door opening. Masking paper/film 12-24 inches from door opening. Spray only — brush work on doors does not generate overspray.

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Exterior door frame/jamb. Same-scope — painted as part of the door unit. Same color and sheen.
Exterior door casing. Separate spec (SF_TRIM_EXT_RP). Typically same color as door trim. Clean junction at casing-to-jamb boundary.
Siding field adjacent to door opening. Separate spec. Typically different color (body vs door). Protection-only relationship. Masking when spray.
Door threshold/sill plate. Protection target only — not painted in this scope.

valid_input_states.notes: 3 repaint input states. SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT and SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT apply to all substrates. SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST is steel-only (RC-001). Chalking and peeling excluded — uncommon on doors (siding phenomenon).

output_state.notes: All repaint input states converge to painted output state. Sheen determined by quality tier and substrate constraints: Steel always satin per ANSI A250.8. Wood/fiberglass: QT3=satin, QT4=semi-gloss, QT5=gloss.

site_condition_rules.affected_tasks: ALL tasks — prep and coating. Applied universally.
site_condition_rules.effect: slab=1.00, panel=1.30, grand_entry=2.00. Applied as time multiplier: effective_rate = base_rate / modifier.
site_condition_rules.notes: Uses FAC_DRRP_COMPLEXITY. Per-door attribute. Grand entry includes sidelites, transom, and complex geometry.

site_condition_rules.affected_tasks: Prep tasks only (cleaning, scraping, sanding, debridement, caulking, dust removal). NOT coating tasks — once prepped, surface is at baseline.
site_condition_rules.effect: SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT=1.00, SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT=1.50, SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST=2.00. Applied as time multiplier: effective_rate = base_rate / modifier.
site_condition_rules.notes: Uses FAC_DRRP_CONDITION. Stacking pool: PREP. Rust is steel-only.

site_condition_rules.affected_tasks: Prep tasks involving paint disturbance (scraping, sanding, power tool cleaning).
site_condition_rules.notes: Uses FAC_DRRP_RRP. Pre-1978 + lead-positive triggers RRP. Stacking pool: PREP. RRP containment setup/teardown are separate fixed tasks.

site_condition_rules.affected_tasks: Coating tasks only (prime, finish). NOT prep tasks.
site_condition_rules.effect: QT3=1.00, QT4=1.25, QT5=1.50. Applied as time multiplier: effective_rate = base_rate / modifier.
site_condition_rules.notes: Uses FAC_DRRP_QT. Stacking pool: COATING. Higher QT = slower pace due to tighter defect tolerance, premium product handling, and interstage sanding.

stacking_partition.description: Modifiers split into non-overlapping pools to prevent compound blowout. Prep and coating tasks share COMPLEXITY but never share CONDITION/RRP with QT.

prep_tasks.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (FAC_DRRP_CONDITION x FAC_DRRP_RRP x FAC_DRRP_COMPLEXITY)
prep_tasks.max_stack_with_rrp: SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST (2.00) x RRP (2.00) x Grand Entry (2.00) = 8.00x — EXCEEDS 4.0x cap. Recommend T&M pricing.
prep_tasks.notes: FAC_DRRP_QT does NOT apply to prep tasks. Extreme stacks (rust + RRP + grand entry) are rare edge cases.

coating_tasks.notes: FAC_DRRP_CONDITION and FAC_DRRP_RRP do NOT apply to coating tasks. Once prepped, surface is at baseline.

fixed_tasks.notes: Mobilization, lead test, RRP containment setup/teardown, protection teardown, equipment cleanup, waste disposal, and walkthrough are fixed-time tasks. No modifiers applied.

hard_stops.description: Structural damage or rot on wood doors. Soft, punky, or structurally compromised wood. Cannot be painted. Requires door replacement or carpentry repair before painting scope can proceed.
hard_stops.notes: Engine must prevent estimation when structural rot is identified during condition assessment.

hard_stops.description: Structural rust on steel doors (beyond surface corrosion). Perforated or structurally compromised steel. Requires door replacement.
hard_stops.notes: Surface rust (SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST) is paintable. Structural rust is not. Determined during condition assessment rust evaluation.

hard_stops.description: Fiberglass door with existing oil-based paint identified during coating ID test. Oil on fiberglass is a previous failure mode. Full removal may be required before repaint can proceed.
hard_stops.notes: Coating ID test (solvent rub) reveals oil/alkyd existing coating on fiberglass = hard stop. Oil over fiberglass = adhesion failure risk.

hard_stops.description: Selected color LRV <30 without IR-reflective coating technology. Standard dark paint causes thermal stress: wood joint failure, steel thermal warping, fiberglass outgassing/blistering.
hard_stops.notes: Material gate — flagged during color approval. When LRV <30, system must select SYS_EXT_DRRP_FINISH_IR_REFLECTIVE instead of SYS_EXT_DRRP_FINISH_ACRYLIC.

hard_stops.action: GATE — add RRP protocol (not hard stop)
hard_stops.description: Pre-1978 building with positive or presumed lead paint. Activates MOD_DRRP_RRP module and FAC_DRRP_RRP modifier. Does NOT stop work — adds EPA RRP containment and wet scraping requirements.
hard_stops.notes: Soft gate — activates additional scope rather than stopping work. Per door where paint disturbance exceeds 2 SF on exterior component.

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Assess (condition, adhesion, rust/moisture, coating ID, lead) → Mobilize (equipment staging, door removal if spray/wood) → Hardware Remove → Protect (weatherstrip, threshold, glass mask, ground cover, siding mask if spray) → RRP Containment (if pre-1978 + lead) → Prep (substrate-specific clean, scrape/feather if failing, rust debride if steel+rust, body fill if QT4+, adhesion scuff sand, caulk frame, six-side verify if wood, dust remove) → Prime (substrate-specific: DTM/zinc/acrylic/stain-block) → Interstage (QT4/QT5: inspect, sand, spot repair) → Finish 1 (brush or spray) → Interstage (QT4/QT5) → Finish 2 (brush or spray) → Reinstall (door rehang, hardware reinstall, weatherstrip reinstall) → Cleanup (protection teardown, final inspect, touch-up, clean equipment, waste disposal, walkthrough)
sequencing_notes.edge_work: No edge work across specs. Door-to-casing junction caulking is THIS spec's responsibility (door side). Casing surface is trim spec's responsibility.
sequencing_notes.protection_sequence: Hardware remove → Weatherstrip protect → Threshold protect → Glass mask (panel/grand_entry) → Ground cover → Siding mask (spray only) → RRP containment (if applicable)
sequencing_notes.key_prohibitions: NO masking hardware (removal is mandatory). NO hydrocarbon solvents on fiberglass. NO sanding on textured fiberglass. NO silicone caulk at door-to-frame junction. NO oil-based products on fiberglass. NO spray without siding masking. NO painting over structural rust or rot (hard stop). NO skipping feather-edge sanding after scraping. NO painting weatherstripping.

relationships.cross_spec_protection_note: Door-to-casing junction caulking: caulk application owned by THIS spec, casing surface prep owned by SF_TRIM_EXT_RP. Siding masking during spray is THIS spec's responsibility. Grand entry sidelite glass masking owned by this spec if sidelites are part of door assembly.
relationships.notes: First exterior door repaint spec. Introduces substrate-material-driven branching (steel/fiberglass/wood), hardware removal as mandatory standard, door complexity modifier (slab/panel/grand_entry), and EA-based exterior estimation. Patterns established here inform future door-related specs.

maintenance_cycles.description: Expected repaint intervals for exterior doors by quality tier, assuming proper prep and application.

cycles.notes: Standard 2-coat repaint satin. Doors take more physical abuse than siding/trim — shorter base cycle. South/west facing doors may be shorter.
Premium 2-coat repaint with interstage sand. Better products and prep extend cycle.
Superior 4-coat system. Maximum film build. Longest cycle. Restoration-quality doors at grand entry may achieve 15+ years with routine maintenance.

maintenance_cycles.routine_maintenance_definition: Annual inspection, touch-up minor nicks and scuffs, re-caulk frame junction as needed, verify weatherstrip condition, clean door surface with mild soap. Adds 3-5 years to repaint interval.

sections_used: ANSI A250.8 steel door sheen limitation
NOT used as estimation modifiers (RC-003 from PaintFactor OS)
Steel sheen limitation per ANSI A250.8

research_corrections.corrected_to: SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST is steel-only. Fiberglass does not rust. Wood deterioration is rot/moisture, not rust. Enforced as constraint in resolution.json and sop_modules.json applies_when rules.

research_corrections.original_claim: Environmental conditions should be estimation modifiers
research_corrections.corrected_to: Environmental conditions are NOT estimatable — unpredictable at bid time. Excluded from spec entirely per PaintFactor OS RC-003.

change_log.author: SpecFactory
change_log.changes: Initial draft spec for exterior door repaint. FIRST EXTERIOR DOOR REPAINT SPEC — introduces substrate-material-driven branching (steel/fiberglass/wood), hardware removal as mandatory standard, door complexity modifier (slab/panel/grand_entry), and EA-based exterior estimation. Key features: combined assess+prep+prime+finish (single mobilization), 3 substrate materials, 3 substrate conditions (sound/failing/rust), 3 complexity levels, 3 quality tiers (QT3-QT5, QT2 excluded), 2 application methods (brush primary, spray conditional on door removal), 50 tasks across 12 modules (28 binary + 16 qt_scaled + 6 qt_conditional), 7 material systems (5 primer + 2 finish), 4 factor modifiers (CONDITION/RRP/QT/COMPLEXITY) with stacking partition, 6 round configurations, 6 protection zones, 21 consumables (including 2 RRP-conditional), 12 variants, 8 PaintScope inputs, 1 paintable item (ITM_DOOR_EXT EA). Modifier stacking: prep max 8.00x with RRP + rust + grand entry (extreme edge — recommend T&M), coating max 3.00x (QT5 + grand entry). 5 gate conditions (2 hard stops + 1 material gate + 1 soft gate + 1 material incompatibility stop). Steel limited to satin per ANSI A250.8. Fiberglass: 100% acrylic only, oil prohibited, no sanding on textured. Wood: six-side seal mandatory, MC testing, stain-block for tannin species.
